title: Edge magnetism in colloidal MoS2 triangular nanoflakes
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,2333-2341
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08271D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Surender Kumar, Stefan Velja, Muhammad Sufyan Ramzan, Caterina Cocchi
Edge topology governs magnetism in S-terminated, H-passivated triangular MoS2 nanoflakes. Beyond ∼1.5 nm, magnetic islands form on specific Mo edge atoms, enabling robust, topology-driven spin control.
